verdicts.reason: Both drop the woman holding the resume (only a stray hand fragment survives in the bottom-right corner), so the key image is gone. A keeps a clean left edge for the text, but its centred rules don't line up with the left-aligned copy, a bullet dot collides with the 's' of 'since 1980', the other dot floats on its own, and the vertical gaps are big and uneven. B is worse: the tilde is pushed off to the right, the four rules have different widths and centres, the dots float above 'since 1980' with no clear relationship to it, 'since 1980' is indented on its own axis, and the bottom 40% of the canvas is dead space.
